improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your AI-powered trade and business assistant. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for operations and trade. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Gideon – AI Trade & Business Assistant | GDN AI">
<meta property="og:description" content="Your Claude-powered assistant for trade and business. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://www.gdnai.com">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://www.gdnai.com/og-gideon-preview.png">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Gideon – AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Claude-powered AI for business owners and traders. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition (AI assistant, trade and business focus, free trial, affordable pricing). Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B trust and social referral traffic. Including the free searches and starting price creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with 'no card required' to reduce friction and boost conversions. Copy is concise, benefit-driven, and establishes trust without making unverified claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to your personal workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users: understanding what happens at the paywall. It reinforces value (unlimited workspace, voice chat, professional support) while clearly stating pricing without pressure, building trust and reducing abandonment at the conversion moment.
